title: Rubies by Mr.Koteyka
description: A mod that adds rubies to Minecraft
body:
The first mod by Mr.K0teyka that adds:
1. New ruby ore that generates in meadows and glows.
2. New block of rubies.
3. The ruby itself, that can be crafted with a diamond and red dye.
4. A set of armour and tools that are like netherite.
